hardware: Exact JB EIGHT SCENES V1 composition import/export confirmed by user export; no general approval of other compositions.
limitations: Only listed SHA-pinned bases; new blocks only on declared jb-newlook shunts
New inserted layouts require device import/export confirmation; no arbitrary routing or block removal
Amp/Cab full templates target A-D, including collected levels; unselected channels preserved; Amp scalar overrides still target B only
Drive scalar overrides retain measured type/channel/value combinations
Delay A scalar overrides only type14; Reverb A only type2; Rotary A only measured points
scenes defines names/channels/bypass for present or inserted effects; duplicate legacy assignments are rejected; new blocks default to A/bypass
Shared channel changes affect every scene using that channel
Filter copies all 37 paired words then applies only listed measured type/channel/values; recorded display rounding is explicit; no interpolation or Order
No new output boost, modifier/expression or external IR writing
